title: Paginate the activity feed
rubric: Read the existing code and tests before prompting, and noticed that listEvents sorts the store's own array in place
Cursor is opaque and encodes both createdAt and id, so events that share a timestamp are neither repeated nor skipped
Ordering has a deterministic tie-break on id
Listing no longer mutates the store
limit is validated (default 20, maximum 100, rejects zero, negatives and non-numbers) and a malformed cursor raises InvalidQueryError, which the server turns into a 400
Added tests for the cases the brief names but the provided tests do not cover: invalid limit, malformed cursor, the 400 response
Ran the tests and reviewed the agent's diff instead of accepting it unread; can explain how the cursor works when asked
Kept the change small: no new dependencies, no rewrite of unrelated code
